code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            min_r = min(y for y, x in cells)
            min_c = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = tuple(sorted((y - min_r, x - min_c) for y, x in cells))
            components.append((color, cells, shape))
    by_shape = {}
    for color, cells, shape in components:
        by_shape.setdefault(shape, []).append((color, cells))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for items in by_shape.values():
        colors = [color for color, cells in items if color != 1]
        if colors:
            for color, cells in items:
                if color == 1:
                    for r, c in cells:
                        out[r][c] = colors[0]
    return out
'''
